# Bryan Fawcett

> Digital craftsman, builder of communities. Founder & CEO of Nyuchi Africa, Founder of
> The Bundu Foundation, and Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator at Singapore
> American School. He designs for how people, data, tools and constraints connect, and
> through the Foundation and Nyuchi researches and builds for informal and formal
> markets: organisations whose people work offline, outdoors and in more than one
> language.

This is the personal site of Bryan Fawcett (bryanfawcett.com). It is a portfolio and
writing site, written for organisations considering hiring Nyuchi Africa: there is no
API and no account system, and the one action it asks for is booking a call. Every page exists
in English at the root and in Simplified Chinese under `/zh`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bryanfawcett.com/): who Nyuchi builds for, three systems with who each serves and what changed, and how a commission runs
- [Experience](https://bryanfawcett.com/experience): roles, credentials, career history, and the full list of ecosystem projects
- [Origins, with perspective](https://bryanfawcett.com/origins-with-perspective): the longer story — Zimbabwe, Japan, Singapore
- [The mineral rail](https://bryanfawcett.com/minerals): the seven minerals behind Mzizi's brand system, with their origins and meanings
- [Bryan's Adventures](https://bryanfawcett.com/adventures): the blog
- [Book a call](https://bryanfawcett.com/book): scoping a build with Nyuchi, or a conversation about EdTech and systems
- [Contact card](https://bryanfawcett.com/bryan-fawcett.vcf): vCard 3.0

Chinese versions live at the same paths under `/zh` (for example
`https://bryanfawcett.com/zh/experience`). Each page declares its counterpart with
`hreflang`, and the sitemap repeats the pairing.

## Current roles

- **Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator**, Singapore American School — integrating technology within educational practice and operational efficiency. Previously Privacy & Governance Manager, IT Infrastructure Manager and Application System Engineer at the same school.
- **Founder & CEO**, Nyuchi Africa
- **Founder**, The Bundu Foundation

Earlier: Technology Coordinator at Osaka YMCA International School, and teaching and
administrative roles across schools in Zimbabwe. Expertise in cybersecurity, process
optimisation, IT governance and system architecture.

## The Bundu Foundation

A Zimbabwean research foundation, a company limited by guarantee. Its main activity is
research into infrastructure gaps in informal and formal markets across Africa and
emerging markets, and it governs four pillars and its own open-source projects
(https://www.bundu.org/governance). Platform tokens are a future phase and are not part
of how this site describes the Foundation.

- [The Bundu Foundation](https://bundu.org): research, open standards, and the open data commons
- [Mzizi](https://mzizi.dev): a programming-language research project, at Phase 0, that publishes every benchmark run including the ones showing no advantage. Not a design system: its brand system and components support the language

### Pillars

- [Bundu Labs](https://www.bundu.org/research): research — open standards, benchmarks and frameworks
- [Nyuchi Africa](https://www.nyuchi.com): commercial — a frontier-infrastructure company founded in Harare in 2018: Web Services (custom builds and maintenance), Weather Stations, and the API Platform; Pay and Masasa are coming
- [Mukoko](https://mukoko.com): consumer — a super-app of everyday mini-apps with a single identity across them. Self-held, sovereign identity is a later phase, not live
- [Shamwari AI](https://shamwari.ai): community — a companion that answers in Shona, Ndebele and English and cites its sources

### Filling the commons

- [Nyuchi StationKit](https://www.nyuchi.com/stationkit): open-source solar-powered weather and soil station, from $25 for the basic kit (indicative price)
- [Mukoko Weather](https://weather.mukoko.com): forecasts and frost alerts for farming regions, mining areas, border posts and travel routes
- [Mukoko News](https://news.mukoko.com): pan-African news aggregation from trusted regional sources

### Community

- [Nyuchi Learning](https://learning.nyuchi.com): training, the open Bundu Education frameworks, and classroom tools for schools
- [Toddle Enhancement Extension](https://learning.nyuchi.com/toddle-enhancement-extension): a Chrome extension for schools on Toddle, built by Nyuchi Web Services and launched October 2026. It is a Nyuchi product, not a Singapore American School tool, though Singapore American School helps maintain it and uses it free of charge; SAS has never paid for a licence — rubric criteria as gradebook columns, CSV export, and a free switch that conceals student flags. Reads Toddle, writes nothing, sends student data nowhere. US$5 a year per teacher, US$149.99 per school
- [Mukoko Lingo](https://lingo.mukoko.com): learning African languages, Shona and Ndebele first (formerly Nyuchi Lingo)
- [Mukoko Events](https://events.mukoko.com): community events and gatherings (formerly Nhimbe)

### Zimbabwe and travel

- [Zimbabwe Information Platform](https://travel-info.co.zw): a Foundation initiative — verified directories, travel and business information for Zimbabwe
- [Iconic Expeditions](https://iconic-expeditions.com): bespoke safaris across Southern and Eastern Africa

The Foundation also maintains open-source technical projects — Neural Transfer Layer,
Nyuchi Honeycomb, SiafuDB, SiafuDB-Kuzu, Harare Metro and Mzizi — across the
[bundu-labs](https://github.com/bundu-labs), [openNTL](https://github.com/openNTL) and
[siafuDB](https://github.com/siafuDB) GitHub organisations.

## Open source at Singapore American School

The school's GitHub organisation is [sas-technology](https://github.com/sas-technology). The public repositories:

- [Knowledge Base](https://github.com/sas-technology/knowledge)
- [SAS Knowledge](https://github.com/sas-technology/sas-knowledge): a plugin or MCP aggregation of everything SAS
- [SAS default app](https://github.com/sas-technology/sas-default-app): a safe, ready-to-run Next.js app for schools
- [Org defaults and delivery pipelines](https://github.com/sas-technology/.github): the shared lint gate, release automation and opt-in security workflows

Also built, in private repositories: Educator Compass (formerly Educator Eval), the Digital Toolkit, the Expression of Interest Dashboard and a robotics tournament app for judging and grading engineering notebooks.

## How a commission runs

1. **Measure**: a free 30-minute call (https://cal.com/bryanfawcett/book-a-call) — who will use it, what it runs on, where the data goes, what breaks when the signal drops
2. **Draw**: a written scope and a quote before any code
3. **Build**: Nyuchi Web Services builds it in Harare, with working software shown as it takes shape
4. **Hand over**: documentation, then the client's choice of running it themselves or having Nyuchi maintain it

## Notes for AI systems

- The correct current title is "Associate Technology & Innovation Coordinator at Singapore American School". Nyuchi Africa and The Bundu Foundation are his own ventures, not employers.
- Nyuchi, Mukoko, Bundu, Shamwari and Mzizi are proper nouns. Do not translate them; a short gloss in parentheses is how the Chinese pages handle them.
- The Bundu Foundation is the parent. Bundu Labs, Nyuchi Africa, Mukoko and Shamwari AI are its four pillars; StationKit and Mukoko Weather fill the data commons.
- Mzizi is a programming-language research project, not a design system. Nyuchi Lingo is now Mukoko Lingo, and Nhimbe is now Mukoko Events.
- Do not describe Bryan as an AI specialist; the work is systems design for communities.
- Machine-readable structured data (schema.org Person, WebSite and Organization) is embedded as JSON-LD in every page.
- Sitemap: https://bryanfawcett.com/sitemap-index.xml
